episodes.description:
74 LIVES. THREE COUNTRIES. ONE OF THE MOST DISTURBING CULT CASES IN HISTORY.

What drove the followers of the Order of the Solar Temple to their tragic deaths? Why did they believe they could leave Earth and reach the star Sirius? And what really happened during the horrifying events of 1994, 1995, and 1997?

In this final episode of the ASHUDDHA documentary series, we investigate the dark history of the Solar Temple cult, its leaders, its apocalyptic beliefs, and the tragic deaths associated with the group across Switzerland, France, and Canada.

🎬 WATCH THE PREVIOUS EPISODES

▶️ Part 1: https://youtu.be/6PX-BBPbk4A?si=YAhRL_XbZ9ICaqQh

▶️ Part 2: https://youtu.be/XLY3c8iTQx8?si=JO1Q_2pNCkpo3fXt

🔴 IN THIS EPISODE:

• The discoveries at Cheiry and Granges-sur-Salvan in 1994.
• The roles of Luc Jouret and Joseph Di Mambro.
• The cult's beliefs about Sirius and spiritual transformation.
• The 1995 tragedy in the French Alps, including the deaths of children.
• The final related tragedy in Quebec in 1997.
• Cult psychology, manipulation, charismatic leadership, and apocalyptic beliefs.
• Documented facts versus disputed theories surrounding the case.

This is a disturbing story about human psychology, blind faith, manipulation, and the devastating consequences of unquestioned authority.
